Title: 2020-12-04 Hotfix Patch
Subtitle: Hogger Hogg Wild hitbox fix and loadout/voice line fixes.
Highlights: Hogger Hogg Wild hitbox fix and loadout/voice line fixes.
CleanedNotes:
=== Shop ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue where several skins and mounts would not be available for selection in the loadout after purchasing.

=== Heroes: Hogger ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue causing Hogger's mesh collision hitbox to not be reduced while Hogg Wild is active.
  • Fixed an issue where Hogger's voice lines could not be properly purchased.

Shop: • Fixed an issue where several skins and mounts would not be available for selection in the loadout after purchasing.
